title: SK海力士拟赴美上市 募资290亿美元 押注AI芯片需求
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Okay, hi, Nick. It's announcing today that it's going to list on the US $29 billion listing.
segments.zh: 你好，尼克。今天SK海力士宣布将在美国上市，融资290亿美元。

segments.en: So, if you didn't have enough of the memory chip stocks and various other AI-related stocks in your portfolio,
segments.zh: 如果你**组合里内存芯片股和AI相关股还不够多，

segments.en: you would have another chance to add to them. But it is a good point, though, right, Peter?
segments.zh: 现在又有机会加仓了。但彼得，你说得对，

segments.en: What you say, the only thing I would push back on is if you need memory chips, you need to renew them in a couple of years, right?
segments.zh: 唯一要反驳的是，内存芯片过几年就得更新，对吧？

segments.en: So, once you gain the business, assuming the switching costs aren't too high, then you keep the business.
segments.zh: 一旦赢得业务，假设转换成本不高，就能留住客户。

segments.en: Yeah, the numbers in these fund raisings are getting pretty amazing.
segments.zh: 这些融资的金额真是惊人。

segments.en: I mean, it's $29 billion that SK Heinix is talking about.
In past years, we talk about what a stunning record that is.
segments.zh: 往年这会是创纪录的数字。

segments.en: This may actually get lost this year because we've had the SpaceX IPO.
segments.zh: 但今年可能被忽略，因为还有SpaceX的IPO。

segments.en: We've had Google's fund raising for tens of billions of dollars, too.
segments.zh: 谷歌也融资了数百亿美元。

segments.en: But for SK Heinix, this is a big deal. So, one of the key constraints in the memory chip industry right now is capacity.
segments.zh: 但对SK海力士来说，这意义重大。目前存储芯片行业的关键制约因素之一是产能。

segments.en: SK Heinix has talked about this Samsung has certainly micron will after the bell today.
segments.zh: SK海力士已讨论过，三星和美光肯定也会在盘后提及。

segments.en: SK Heinix wants to be able to raise this $29 billion to be able to build additional capacity.
segments.zh: SK海力士希望筹集290亿美元以增加产能。

segments.en: They're building in South Korea. They're also building some facilities in the United States.
segments.zh: 他们在韩国和美国都在建设新设施。

segments.en: So, they want to be able to add that capacity. This is something, of course, that their customers really want, because they don't want to see these soaring prices anymore.
segments.zh: 他们希望增加产能，客户也乐见其成，因为不想再看到价格飙升。
